scope: Retain source H roles for ordered LTYPE_CONTROL members and report a mismatched non-null ownership role without changing tolerant parsing or callbacks.

authority.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.finding: Counted LTYPE_CONTROL members are soft owners (code 2); the final BYBLOCK and BYLAYER phantom members are hard owners (code 3). Physical ODA evidence resolves producer order as BYBLOCK then BYLAYER for the observed profiles; other producer ordering remains open.

implementation.retention: DRW_ObjControl now retains each ordered member's original H code, including null slots, in an internal vector parallel to orderedHandleSlots.
implementation.diagnostic: readDwgTables records the first non-null LTYPE_CONTROL member role mismatch as DwgIntegrityCheckKind::TableControlHandleRole, anchored to the source control frame and identifying the member handle plus expected/observed role.
implementation.compatibility: The parser continues to accept historical all-soft libdxfrw members and tolerant callbacks are unchanged. The Error diagnostic causes existing strict and bounded-partial consumers to refuse the source.
implementation.abi: The internal DRW_ObjControl layout changes. The public DwgIntegrityCheckKind receives appended value 40; prior values remain stable and DwgIntegrityDiagnosticSchemaVersion remains 1.

validation.result: Build passed with -Werror; focused CTests passed 4/4 in 0.64 seconds. Generated controls verify null and non-null raw-role retention, correct-role acceptance, source-anchored Error reporting through the table traversal, tolerant malformed-role parsing, and multi-version reset/retry compatibility.
validation.fixtures: No fixture was added or modified. The integration control reads the existing tracked ordinary_enc_AC1015.dwg only to obtain its table-control handles.

limitations: Only the first non-null role mismatch in one control is reported; one Error is sufficient for strict refusal.
Null member references are not diagnosed by this role category; required phantom membership remains open.
This does not bind each control member to the same typed LTYPE target and emitted reference, qualify source producer breadth, or resolve the BYBLOCK/BYLAYER order for other producers.
No physical-source or native-linetype support claim is made.
